findings.title: «कम्युनिटी» vs the audited switcher «समुदाय»
findings.note: The Team Bridge switcher audited on PR #1970 (scope.group.communities, scope.community.*) and all 11 shipped hi uses say «समुदाय»; this file says «कम्युनिटी» 18 times, so the switcher and the home it opens name the same thing differently. समुदाय is masculine, so agreement changes where it governs (outcome.limit.note «पूरे समुदाय पर»); suggested values account for that.

findings.title: «इमेज» vs shipped «तस्वीर»
findings.note: Shipped hi says «तस्वीर/तस्वीरें» for image 117 times, 29 of them on the Team Bridge composer (ui.teamBridge.attachments.*: «तस्वीरें जोड़ें», «{count, plural, one {# तस्वीर} other {# तस्वीरें}}», «सभी तस्वीरें हटाएँ»); this file uses «इमेज» 11 times, and «# इमेज» also loses the plural. join.disclosure.body is the one value only this finding touches.

values.ui.community.join.disclosure.body: संदेश, इमेज और एजेंट पोस्ट पहले एक स्वचालित मॉडरेटर जाँचता है। अगर कुछ अस्वीकार होता है, तो वह न पोस्ट होता है न सहेजा जाता है, और चेतावनी सिर्फ़ आपको दिखती है।
values.ui.community.composer.image_rejected.typ: सिर्फ़ PNG, JPEG और WebP इमेज जोड़ी जा सकती हैं।
values.ui.community.composer.image_rejected.siz: इमेज अधिकतम 5 MiB की हो सकती है।

findings.note: Mechanical checks at aeecfe4a: key set and order equal English (172); every value parses with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and has the same argument names/types as English; plural arms present for the locale's CLDR categories; U+2026 ellipsis, never ASCII '...'; no bidi control characters; product names (Radient, Radient Console, Team Bridge, Local Operator Community) and #general byte-intact. All 28 suggested values were parsed the same way. Rendered fit and RTL layout not verified (no browser tool in this lane).

Accepted after reading all 172 values: आप register and polite imperatives; danda for full stops; nukta kept (फ़, ज़); Latin digits; one/other plurals (with M2b-hi fixing the invariant «इमेज» arms); एजेंट matches the glossary.
